title: Fournier's Gangrene in Patient With Uncontrolled Type 2 Diabetes
brief_summary: A 66-year-old man, with a history of uncontrolled type 2 diabetes, obesity with BMI 38, chronic kidney failure and chronic heart failure, was admitted to the Emergency Department with a large area of necrosis involving the perineal and perianal regions.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Clinical diagnosis of Fournier's Gangrene Insulin dependent diabetes (type 2)

Exclusion Criteria:

n/a
